118188.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Oregon
118188.note: CrownHeights.info, 8 Aug 2023: 'Chabad of Oregon was founded in 1984 when Rabbi Moshe and Devora Wilhelm moved to the city with two of their young children to establish Chabad-Lubavitch of Oregon.' CrownHeights.info, 5 Apr 2017, says the same: 'when the senior Wilhelms arrived in 1984'.

118601.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Southern Oregon
118601.note: CrownHeights.info, 12 Jan 2016: 'Rabbi Avi and Faigy Zwiebel have been serving Ashland's Jewish community since 2003, leading most of their popular activities and programs out of their home.' CrownHeights.info, 25 July 2017: the Zwiebels 'moved to the bucolic area ... in 2003.'

449303.name: Chabad of Hillsboro
449303.note: CrownHeights.info, 1 Feb 2007, 'Chabad launches Intel center in Hillsboro': 'Rivkin arrived in Oregon Jan. 9 with his wife Chaya and 7-month-old twins'; programs run from their home at 870 NE Caden Ave.; 'The Hillsboro Chabad Center is the fourth established by Chabad Lubavitch of Oregon.' Its chabad.org listing went up 15 Jan 2007.

566599.name: Chabad at Portland Campuses
566599.note: CrownHeights.info, 10 Sept 2007: 'On Aug. 14, Rabbi Dov and Chani Bialo arrived in Portland with their daughters', to run a Chabad House for the students of all the Portland campuses. Its chabad.org listing went up 10 Sept 2007.

597075.name: Chabad-Lubavitch of Central Oregon
597075.note: Jewish Review on CrownHeights.info, 9 Mar 2008: 'Rabbi Yitzchok and Mimi Feldman arrived in Bend in late November to set up the eighth Chabad Center in Oregon.' Its chabad.org listing went up 20 Nov 2007.
